schema:
CREATE TABLE jp_stations (
                hex_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                code_integer INTEGER NOT NULL,
                csv_names_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                csv_primary_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                station_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                station_original_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                station_source TEXT NOT NULL,
                station_code TEXT NOT NULL,
                prefecture INTEGER NOT NULL,
                latitude REAL NOT NULL,
                longitude REAL NOT NULL,
                address TEXT NOT NULL,
                line_codes_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                match_method TEXT NOT NULL,
                confidence REAL NOT NULL,
                is_pseudo INTEGER NOT NULL,
                pseudo_id TEXT,
                error_center_latitude REAL,
                error_center_longitude REAL,
                error_radius_km REAL
            );
CREATE INDEX idx_jp_stations_code_integer ON jp_stations (code_integer);
CREATE INDEX idx_jp_stations_station_name ON jp_stations (station_name);
CREATE INDEX idx_station_edges_from ON station_edges (from_station_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_station_edges_to ON station_edges (to_station_code);

CREATE TABLE station_edge_paths (line_code TEXT NOT NULL, from_station_code TEXT NOT NULL, to_station_code TEXT NOT NULL, geohash_path TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (line_code,from_station_code,to_station_code)) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE tunion_stations (
            station_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            city_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            city_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            line_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
            station_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            normalized_station_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            match_status TEXT NOT NULL,
            match_quality TEXT NOT NULL,
            match_source TEXT,
            match_query TEXT,
            latitude REAL,
            longitude REAL,
            display_name TEXT,
            osm_type TEXT,
            osm_id TEXT,
            importance REAL,
            osm_name TEXT,
            osm_name_zh TEXT,
            osm_name_en TEXT,
            osm_name_ja TEXT,
            osm_names_json TEXT,
            last_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        , source_code TEXT, source_type TEXT, source_line_name TEXT, source_station_name TEXT, source_tripreader_json TEXT);

CREATE TABLE station_edges (
            line_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            from_station_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            to_station_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            distance_km REAL NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (line_code, from_station_code, to_station_code)
        );

CREATE TABLE tunion_lines (
            city_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            line_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            line_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            station_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
            source_city_folder TEXT,
            source_csv_file TEXT,
            PRIMARY KEY (city_id, line_code, line_name, station_type)
        );

CREATE TABLE tunion_terminal_stations (
            record_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (record_kind IN ('18', '1e')),
            city_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            terminal_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            station_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            line_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            station_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            station_key TEXT REFERENCES tunion_stations(station_key),
            source_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (record_kind, city_id, terminal_code)
        ) WITHOUT ROWID
        ;

CREATE TABLE cityunion_terminal_prefixes (
            terminal_prefix TEXT PRIMARY KEY, city_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            station_name TEXT NOT NULL, line_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            station_type TEXT NOT NULL, station_key TEXT,
            source_json TEXT NOT NULL
        ) WITHOUT ROWID
    ;
CREATE INDEX idx_tunion_edges_from ON station_edges (from_station_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_tunion_edges_to ON station_edges (to_station_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_tunion_line_key ON tunion_stations (line_key);
CREATE INDEX idx_tunion_match_status ON tunion_stations (match_status, match_quality);
CREATE INDEX idx_tunion_station_name ON tunion_stations (station_name);

CREATE TABLE station_edge_paths (line_code TEXT NOT NULL, from_station_code TEXT NOT NULL, to_station_code TEXT NOT NULL, geohash_path TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (line_code,from_station_code,to_station_code)) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE stations (
                    station_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                    station_name_mn TEXT NOT NULL,
                    station_name_en TEXT NOT NULL,
                    latitude REAL NOT NULL,
                    longitude REAL NOT NULL
                );

CREATE TABLE routes (
                    route_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                    route_name_mn TEXT NOT NULL,
                    route_name_en TEXT NOT NULL,
                    endpoint_name_mn TEXT NOT NULL,
                    endpoint_name_en TEXT NOT NULL
                );
CREATE INDEX route_stations_station_id_idx ON route_stations(station_id);
